display.summary: Locked section saves, one declared rule for stored-vs-project settings, and ScanLink out of the live preview.
highlights: Two admins saving different System Settings sections at the same time both keep their changes.
Stored settings override the project's DLUX_CONFIG by one declared policy; an untouched group never masks it before setup.
Extra Features and app namespaces merge with the project's per entry instead of replacing them all.
Toggling ScanLink (or any nonvisual control) no longer reloads the page behind the Options modal.
The import review groups changes by the step that edits them; group aliases, defaults and import names are derived from one registry.
